description:
Why should you join Jerry?

  • Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 40X revenue growth in 4 years | $2T market size).

  • Work closely with brilliant leaders and teammates from companies like McKinsey, BCG, Nvidia, Better, NerdWallet, SoFi, etc.

  • Disrupt a massive market and help scale us to a $5B business in the next few years.

  • Be immersed in a talent-dense environment and accelerate your career growth exponentially.

  • Own Jerry’s acquisition messaging end to end across a growing product lineup, from car insurance to home, renters, motorcycle, and RV & boat insurance, plus property tax appeals.

About the Role

At Jerry, we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners’ needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers — and we’re just getting started. Now we’re expanding beyond the car to help people protect and save on their broader physical assets, with motorcycle, home, renters, and RV & boat insurance, and property tax appeals.

We’re looking for a Conversion Copywriter with direct-response instincts and a testing mindset. You’re someone who knows that one headline can move CPA more than a budget change. You’ll own the words across our acquisition funnel (search ads, paid social copy, and landing pages), and define how each new product shows up for customers from day one. You’ll write, test, and iterate on them at high speed, using AI to multiply your output without lowering the bar. You’ll report to our Creative Lead and work day to day with our SEM, paid social, and growth teams

Why you will (or won’t) like working here:

  • Your work is measured. Every line you write is tested against CTR, CVR, and CPA. If you love seeing the impact of your words in the data, you’ll thrive. If you’d rather write one perfect manifesto, this isn’t the role.

  • Build from zero: We’re launching several new products, and each one needs its story written for the first time. You’ll create the foundational value props: positioning, proof points, and the first messages tested in market. You’ll be building those, not just tweaking copy that already works.

  • End-to-end ownership: You’ll build the messaging foundation (angles, proof points, an approved-claims library) that the all marketing channels, website, app store all draw from. You’ll also write the RSAs yourself.

  • Insurance is not “sexy,” and it’s regulated: People think about insurance when a renewal bill arrives, and nobody wakes up excited about a property tax appeal. Can you make savings feel real and trustworthy, and stay compliant while doing it?

What You’ll Do

  • Write and iterate acquisition copy across channels: Google RSAs, Meta and TikTok primary text and headlines, YouTube and CTV supers, and landing pages.

  • Build foundational value propositions for new products: For each new product (motorcycle, home, renters, RV & boat insurance, property tax appeal), research the customer, the competitors, and what makes Jerry different. Then define the core UVP, the messaging hierarchy, and the proof points, and validate them quickly through paid tests.

  • Own the testing roadmap for copy: form hypotheses, structure tests so they produce clear learnings, read the results, and ship the next round quickly.

  • Develop angles, hooks, and messaging frameworks grounded in customer insight. You’ll dig through app reviews, support tickets, call transcripts, and Reddit for the language customers actually use.

  • Make landing pages convert: keep the message consistent from ad to page, structure the page as an argument, handle objections, and add trust signals. You’ll partner with marketers and growth PMs on CRO.

  • Build and maintain Jerry’s messaging and claims library: pre-approved value propositions, proof points, and compliant claims, created with Legal and used across all marketing channels, website, and app store for every product line.

  • Partner with media and analytics: turn search terms, auction data, and performance signals into better copy.

  • Use AI tools to generate variants at scale, build prompt libraries and voice guides others can run, and stay the editor and strategist rather than the typist.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years of performance or direct-response copywriting: ideally in-house at a growth-stage app, fintech, insurtech, or lead-gen company, and/or at a performance marketing agency.

  • Proven track record, with numbers: a portfolio that shows lifts in CTR, CVR, or CPA, not just polished work.

  • Channel fluency: you know RSA mechanics (pinning, character limits, how Google combines assets), Quality Score, platform-native social copy, and landing page best practices.

  • Testing and data literacy: you can pull your own reports, read results critically, and know the difference between a winner and noise.

  • Positioning chops: you’ve defined value props or messaging for a new product or category launch, not just optimized existing copy.

  • Range: you can write rational, intent-driven search copy and emotional, scroll-stopping social hooks.

  • AI fluency: you actively use generative tools in your writing workflow and can show us how.

  • Collaborative, low-ego, fast: you’re happy to kill your own darlings when the data says so.

  • (Plus) Experience in a regulated category: comfortable writing within compliance (insurance, financial services, health) and working efficiently with Legal.

  • (Plus) lifecycle/CRM or UX writing experience; experience at an insurance or financial comparison marketplace; or experience across multiple insurance lines (home, renters, specialty vehicles) or in property or real estate.

Why This Role Matters

Copy touches every dollar we spend on acquisition, yet today it’s written on the side by channel owners. As Jerry expands from car insurance into motorcycle, home, renters, and RV & boat insurance and property tax appeals, every new product needs a sharp, differentiated story from day one. We need a dedicated owner of our messaging: someone who defines those value props, increases how fast we test, and keeps every claim compliant and consistent across products.

You’ll be the connective tissue between customer insight and conversion, building a scalable messaging system that blends craft, data, AI, and media strategy.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at recruiting@jerry.ai

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.
